title: Winter and House
author: G. M. Yarrow
blurb: Astrid Eriksen, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
